notes.title: Demo Results & Roadmap
notes.content:
It may seem like the investigation has come to a halt... but that only means we're preparing something truly big! We're excited to share some important news and our plans for the future.

As promised, the first players who successfully completed the demo will receive a full game key. To our surprise, there were more of you than we expected! Watching you play and reading your feedback, critiques, and kind words has been incredibly rewarding for us. We truly appreciate every single one of you!

A special thanks to our streamers—your broadcasts have helped us understand our audience better and refine our vision for the project. You won’t be left empty-handed: streamers will receive game keys for personal playthroughs or giveaways for their communities (or maybe both? Keep an eye out!).

Thanks to your reports, the demo was continuously improved throughout the festival—from minor fixes to major quality-of-life enhancements. This game is evolving because of our combined efforts.

[h3]Now, let’s take a look at what’s ahead![/h3]

You are about to experience a gripping story, where your role goes far beyond that of a simple investigator. Prepare to explore unexpected locations, face difficult moral choices that could jeopardize everything, and navigate through three chapters packed with some of the most intricate and immersive puzzles—many inspired by real-life investigation techniques. Ciphers? Over time, they’ll become second nature to you. But what if I told you that you’ll need to learn how to code? Or perhaps conduct scientific experiments and tests?

We can’t wait to share all of this with you inside the full game. Thank you for sticking with us—your support means everything! 💙

notes.title: 🚨 Reactoryx Demo is Now Available! 🚨
notes.content:
🚨 Reactoryx Demo is Now Available! 🚨

Detectives, it’s time to put your investigative skills to the test! 🔍 The Reactoryx demo is officially live on Steam! Play the first chapter, The Last Inspector, and dive into a web of corporate secrets, hidden documents, and cryptic reports.

🕵️‍♂️ What to Expect in the Demo?
✅ Search for hidden clues, reports, and evidence
✅ Solve intricate puzzles that shape the story
✅ Submit detailed reports—your choices matter
✅ Uncover subtle hints and hidden easter eggs

This is just the beginning. The demo sets the tone, but the full case will take you much deeper into the mystery. Pay close attention—everything may not be as it seems.

🔗 Play the demo now: Reactoryx on Steam

Let us know what you uncover… if you dare... 📝👁️ but what!

🚨 Reactoryx Tester Challenge! 🚨

Think you have what it takes to crack the case? The first 10 players who complete the demo and leave an in-game report will receive a free key for the full game upon release! 🔍🎁

📌 How to participate?
1️⃣ Play the Reactoryx demo.
2️⃣ Complete the investigation and submit your in-game report.
3️⃣ Be one of the first 10 to finish!

💬 Winners will be contacted via Discord. If Discord is blocked, send your proof to blackoutinteractivestudio@gmail.com.

Good luck, detectives! 🕵️‍♂️🔎

notes.title: Reactoryx Joins the Upcoming Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce that Reactoryx will be part of the upcoming Steam Next Fest, where you’ll get the chance to play our demo and experience the gripping detective story firsthand!

In the demo, you’ll investigate the mysterious disappearance of an ███████ inside a classified research ██████. Every clue you find and every detail in your report will shape the course of the investigation—so stay sharp!
